summary.text: Mike Griffith is a Republican member of the Maryland House of Delegates from District 35A, which covers parts of Cecil and Harford counties, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A U.S. Marine Corps veteran and business development professional, he has served in the House since 2020 and sits on the Ways and Means Committee.

paragraphs.text: Griffith was born in Baltimore and graduated from Joppatowne High School.
He served in the U.S. Marine Corps from 1995 to 2002 as a military police officer, supervisor and liaison.

His later career included positions in advertising and business development at The Baltimore Sun, Ripken Baseball and the Baltimore Business Journal, work as vice president and chief marketing officer of HPS Management from 2017 to 2024, and a role as director of business development at Albers & Associates beginning in 2024.
Griffith has been a member of the House of Delegates since January 7, 2020, and was first elected in November 2022.
He sits on the Ways and Means Committee and its Early Childhood and Special Education and Revenues subcommittees, and is House vice chair of the Maryland Veterans Caucus.
He received the Maryland Military Coalition's Legislator of the Year award in 2024.
